notes: OpenD 10.9.6918 pairs with the pinned futu-api SDK 10.9.6908 (the lockfile pin); the four-part version need not match exactly because FUTU ships no 10.9.6918 PyPI release.

Ubuntu 24.04 runtime. The OpenD binary is dynamically linked but ships its own libssl/libcurl/libprotobuf, so it only needs the standard glibc libs present on 24.04. It runs non-root, read-only (except the state/tmp mounts), fully capability-dropped, and on an internal-only network to bound the risk surface.
Known CVE exceptions and compatibility notes recorded here are reviewed during every FUTU upgrade PR.
